name: Langfuse AI Gateway
desc: Self-hosted gateway that routes model calls and traces them in Langfuse.
desc_zh: 转发模型调用并把调用链路写进 Langfuse 的开源网关。
solves: Teams end up with provider keys scattered across services and no single view of spend; one entry point routes every call and records it.
solves_zh: 各家密钥散落在不同服务里，花费也没有统一视图；一个入口转发所有调用并记录下来。
best_for: You are adding a second model provider and do not want to touch every call site.
best_for_zh: 你要接第二家模型供应商，却不想改每一处调用。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — langfuse.com/changelog and /blog; B — Show HN 2026-11-13）。 Blog post dated November 9, 2026. A separate product surface from the Langfuse tracing platform the ledger holds; the site navigation lists it as its own product. Show HN on Hacker News (Nov 13, 2026) describes it as an open source Rust gateway. 首次公开日期来源：https://langfuse.com/blog/introducing-gateway
